transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I came in because most days I just feel really low… like I’m stuck at the bottom of a dark hole. Even when I’m around people I know, I can’t shake this heavy, hopeless feeling.
How long have you been feeling this way most days?
About a year and two months now. It really started after that fall on the HVAC job, when I hurt my back, and after that everything just kind of started unraveling.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that it’s hard to get interested in activities you used to like?

Yeah. I used to really like hiking, painting, going to the makerspace and tinkering with stuff… even figuring out a difficult install at work felt good. Now I’ll just sit there and stare at the supplies, or I don’t answer when people call to do something, because none of it feels worth even starting.
Do you feel down or sad most of the time, even when there’s no clear reason for it?
Yes. Most days I feel really down, like I’m stuck at the bottom of a dark hole. Even if I’m around people I know, that heavy, hopeless feeling is still there.
Have you noticed that you feel more tired or have less energy than usual, even when you’re not doing much physically?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I don’t feel great, but I haven’t paid attention to whether it’s more tired than usual or just… how things have been.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to think clearly, focus, or make decisions lately?

Yeah. I’ve noticed that a lot. Paperwork and repair diagrams that used to be easy for me just kind of blur together now. I’ll sit there looking at the screen and can’t even decide something simple, like which form I’m supposed to open first.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty about things you’ve done—or didn’t do—lately?

Yes. I keep thinking I’m useless now because I can’t work the way I used to. I go over every apprentice I feel like I let down, every bill I haven’t paid, and it all just feels like proof that I’ve ruined everything.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless?

Yes. Everything feels slower than it should. Just getting up from the couch and going to the kitchen takes me a while, and even answering a simple question, I feel like I’m lagging. People have been asking if I’m okay because I guess I move like I’m underwater.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living, or have you thought about hurting yourself?

Yeah… I have. I’ve been having thoughts like maybe everyone would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And sometimes, when the pain and the money stuff pile up, I catch myself thinking about ending it. It scares me, but the thoughts are there.
